skills.name: home-assistant-admin
skills.description: Use when the user asks to add, pair, rename, tidy, automate or display anything in Home Assistant — "listen for new Zigbee / Z-Wave / RFXCOM devices", "rename my entities properly", "put this in the kitchen", "create an automation / a script / a scene", "make me a dashboard", "what is wrong with my installation". The method and the exact commands to administer a Home Assistant installation through Allkin's Home Assistant service, without breaking what already runs.

skills.name: manage-actions
skills.description: Use when the user wants something done later, again and again, or whenever something happens on the machine — "every morning", "remind me tomorrow", "each Monday", "warn me when a sign-in fails", "when an agent fails, look into it", "after an update". Creates, reviews and deletes Allkin's actions, at a time or on an event of the event log.
